subject: Medora Health data removal handshake and proof request
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@medorahealth.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Data deletion request - patient exports (prod-774)

Hi Diego,

We have an urgent GDPR erasure request for user data originating from our integration with Redwood (account: Medora Health, environment: prod-774). Our privacy team has identified a small set of patient exports that need to be removed from your systems and we also need proof of deletion for our audit.

Specifically we need:
- Confirmation of the scope (object ids, export filenames) you hold for prod-774
- A deletion timeline and responsible contact
- An evidence package after deletion (logs and a signed statement) that we can retain for compliance

Attached is a redacted export example (we include one record) and a reference to the request id in our tracker: MH-2026-185.

Can you confirm receipt and next steps?

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Privacy Lead, Medora Health
elena.ramos@medorahealth.com

Attachment: sample_export_redacted.csv (sample, redacted)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Data deletion request - patient exports (prod-774)

Forwarding Elena's request — tagging privacy + legal for SOP and controller/processor mapping.

High level: Medora needs deletion + proof. They reference prod-774 and tracker MH-2026-185. Priorities: ID verification, scope, and then execution window. Monica — can you own the DSR runbook and draft the evidence package template? Karthis — please confirm whether this is controller or processor scoped work (Medora as controller), and whether SCCs/DPA need re-affirmation before we proceed.

Thanks,
Diego

---------- Forwarded message ----------
${ELENA_FORWARD}

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Data deletion request - patient exports (prod-774)

Diego / Karthis,

I can take point on the execution and evidence package. Proposed checklist (quick):

1) Scope verification (within 24h):
   - Ask Medora to confirm user IDs or provide hashed identifiers and the export filenames (we have prod-774 namespace).
   - Request signed proxy if request is submitted by a delegate (DocuSign link).

2) Identity & authorization (48h):
   - Verify request origin and confirm account owner.

3) Extraction of affected artifacts (48–72h):
   - Generate export_manifest.csv: list of objects, last-modified, storage location (S3 path / DB table).

4) Deletion window & execution (72–120h):
   - Soft-delete then hard-delete per retention policy, record operation IDs.

5) Evidence package (post-delete):
   - deletion_report_template.xlsx (operations IDs, timestamps, operator)
   - system logs (redacted) showing delete ops (we'll provide log ranges, not full logs)
   - signed confirmation from Redwood legal/security
6) Delivery:
   - Upload to secure share and notify Medora.

I will attach export_manifest.csv and a blank deletion_report_template.xlsx for them to see the format.

Attachments: export_manifest.csv, deletion_report_template.xlsx

Notes: We should keep a minimal internal audit trail for compliance; do not include PHI in the delivered evidence (redact any patient identifiers).

Monica
Privacy Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T13:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Data deletion request - patient exports (prod-774)

Quick legal/controls note:

- Controller/processor: Medora is the controller and Redwood acts as processor for the customer data in this integration. That means we execute deletion on instruction and provide proof; we do not alter the legal basis.

- SCCs / DPA: Medora's request references SCCs and a signed DPA. We have an active DPA and SCC addendum for Medora; link: https://redwood.app/dpa/medora (internal). Before we hand over logs/evidence, confirm the DPA remains in effect and request a short attestation from Medora legal if the request is via a non-account-owner.

- Evidence scope: Provide operation ids + redacted logs + signed confirmation. Avoid raw PHI. For audit purposes we can also reference our latest SOC 2 report (redwood-soc2-2026.pdf) — attach to the package if they request controls evidence.

I'll prepare a short statement on controller/processor handling and a legal attestation template they can sign.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-soc2-2026.pdf (control report, 2026)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@medorahealth.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-14T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data deletion request - patient exports (prod-774)

Elena — thanks for raising this. Next steps and timeline from Redwood: 

1) Please confirm the list of object ids or provide hashed IDs for the records you want removed (reply to this thread). If someone is filing on behalf of Medora, please complete the proxy/authorization here: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-Proxy-Form-123

2) Once we have scope and authorization, Monica will run the extraction (export_manifest.csv) and we will schedule deletion. Expected window: 3–5 business days from verified instruction.

3) After deletion we will deliver an evidence package containing: deletion_report_template.xlsx (operation ids and timestamps), redacted system logs covering the delete ops, and a signed Redwood confirmation. We can also include our SOC 2 summary if you want controls context.

I have copied Karthis for the legal attestation confirming controller/processor roles and the DPA link (https://redwood.app/dpa/medora).

If that scope and timeline works, please reply with MH-2026-185 + the list of ids, or sign the proxy. We'll prioritize once we have verification.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Customer Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com

Attachments (for your reference): redwood-soc2-2026.pdf
